decision: A_GO OPERATIONAL CONCENTRATION GO; EAST-OF-PHILIPPINES BATTLE COMMITMENT STILL CONDITIONAL.
why: The scale and breadth of the 11 Jun raid removes the remaining doubt that TF58 is conducting a major Marianas shaping operation rather than a minor nuisance raid.
The fleet is now sufficiently trained that continued passive dispersion risks missing the amphibious commitment; logistics/concentration must begin.
However, no confirmed transport concentration/landing geometry and no fresh carrier track exist by 11 Jun night. Yamamoto still refuses a blind eastward carrier hunt.
orders_effective_11Jun_night: Five-carrier core and heavy surface pool prepare controlled concentration toward the Guimaras/central-Philippines refuel-and-sortie system beginning 12 Jun under EMCON and ASW cover.
Yamato/Musashi remain with the main Pacific battle pool because KON/Biak is absent.
Oilers move to planned A-GO replenishment positions; avoid a single exposed anchorage.
Marianas reconnaissance prioritizes amphibious shipping confirmation and TF58 bearing updates, not revenge sorties.
Secondary carriers remain a separately controlled reserve/support pool pending the 12-13 Jun geometry and do not automatically merge with the five fast core.
next_release_trigger: Confirmed amphibious shipping/shore-bombardment commitment OR persistent high-quality TF58 track. Re-evaluate 12 Jun after convoy/airfield/bombardment picture.
